surface: A read-only grid: its cells' read-only state, and Enter, typing and Delete changing nothing.

steps.note: The page holds three grids; the setup selects A1 of the second, which sets `readOnly: true` and its default dimmed styling. ArrowRight moves to B1. Every cell carries `aria-readonly`. Required: the value and the read-only state.
Enter opens no editor on a read-only cell and moves the selection down (enterMoves), to B2.
Typing opens no editor and changes nothing. Nothing is required: the transcript records what a reader says when nothing happens.
Delete clears nothing. Nothing is required.
B3, read-only like every cell of the grid.
Back on B2, which still holds `B2`: the typing and Delete changed nothing.
